name: Downhole gas and water separation
principle: Gravity or hydrocyclone separators split produced fluid downhole so the oil-rich stream is lifted and the water-rich stream is reinjected into another zone. Trials show properly operating systems may cut water brought to surface by about 75%.

process_steps.name: Packers isolate the zone and feed the intake

performance.basis: majority of properly operating DOWS in trials

source.note: Wikipedia, Downhole oil-water separation technology, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.basis: Separation near 100% up to 500 bpd liquid rate, remaining above 80% at higher rates.

source.note: Olubode et al., downhole separation (J. Pet. Sci. Eng. 2022), read 2026-11-17

limitations: Downhole gas separation is not covered by the source read

sources.note: Wikipedia, Downhole oil-water separation technology, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

notes: Process provenance: Documents the in-well separation sequence - packers isolate the producing zone and seal the DOWS intake, produced fluids enter the intake, a hydrocyclone separates the stream, the oil/gas-rich stream is lifted while the water-rich stream is injected into a separate disposal zone via ESP or reservoir pressure.
